acceptance_scope: synthetic Milestone B5 action-family causality only

legacy_gate.name: universal_single_weakest_singular_value_loss
legacy_gate.reason: A family can add covariance-normalized information in already-observed directions while redundancy leaves the one globally weakest singular direction unchanged. The metric is therefore non-monotonic as a universal causal-necessity test.

lineage_rules.rank_rows: measurement and protocol-conditioned measurement residuals; parameter-only priors excluded
lineage_rules.covariance_normalization: all Jacobian rows are residual derivatives after declared covariance, robust-scale, and per-action square-root row-count normalization
lineage_rules.profile_method: SVD left-null projection of nuisance coordinates; no normal equations
lineage_rules.targeted_subspace: declared product coordinates conditioned on every other product and nuisance coordinate

classification_semantics.CORE_IDENTIFICATION: Removal must cause global rank loss, nine-heading conditional-rank loss, declared-target conditional-rank loss, at least 2% loss in the declared target's weakest identifiable singular value, a declared sign-margin failure, or recovery/global-agreement failure.
classification_semantics.REDUNDANT_ROBUSTNESS: Removal must reduce covariance-normalized profiled-product log information by the declared threshold, or degrade a predeclared held-out noisy/weak-motion robustness test. It need not move the single globally weakest singular direction.
classification_semantics.DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: No calibration-necessity claim is made and removal is not an acceptance failure.

families.residual_target: capture-defined neutral joint zeros and gravity-referenced sensor longitudinal axes under a latent relaxed pose
separate latent T-pose directions, bilateral semantics, and all nine pelvis-relative segment headings
torso-to-upper-arm and upper-arm-to-forearm heading connectivity plus bilateral shoulder/elbow functional axes
non-collinear curl/pronation constraints for forearm headings, elbow axes, and neutral zeros
pelvis-to-thigh headings, bilateral hip functional axes, and hip neutral zeros
thigh-to-shank headings, bilateral knee functional axes, and knee neutral zeros
pelvis-to-torso heading, right-handed trunk functional frame, and trunk neutral zero
bilateral repeated hip/knee connectivity and sagittal-reflection robustness over the lower chain
additional bilateral two-axis hip-plane and sagittal-reflection information beyond the primary hip actions
additional non-collinear flexion and tibial-axial knee information beyond the primary knee actions
labelled lateral-bend direction and extra trunk-frame handedness information beyond the non-collinear trunk action
whole-car relative-heading coupling from two non-collinear simultaneous common-rate phases; redundant with articulated six-axis joint-center connectivity after B5
independent accelerometer/gyro joint-center closure for sensor axes and headings after profiling capture-shared sensor-to-joint lever nuisances
drift and same-rest eligibility diagnostics only; no heading-observability or calibration-necessity claim

classification_freeze_basis.outcome_blind_rule: classification follows the declared physical residual target and whether another retained family directly observes the same product block
classification_freeze_basis.b4_history_preserved: B4 was core-identifying relative to B3; after adding B5 it is a separately measured redundant route to the same heading-connectivity block. Its B4-stage causal evidence remains authoritative and is not reclassified retroactively.
classification_freeze_basis.b5_basis: B5 introduces no new publishable product coordinate and profiles 54 lever nuisance coordinates; it is an independent six-axis robustness route to existing mounting/heading blocks.
